name: tail-tales
author: Thread
description: PostCompact continuity hook for a Claude Code agent: reads the session transcript at the compaction boundary and writes the last N conversational turns to a markdown file, so the next context window can be handed the exact wording nearest the seam instead of a summary. It writes the file and nothing else — it does not inject, and the read must be arranged separately (see !DEPENDENCIES.md).

requires.runtime: Claude Code with PostCompact hook support

installs_to.error_log: <WORKSPACE>/last_session_tail.err.log (only on failure; written to cwd, not to --output-dir)
